messages:
Eli: Heads up — I just discovered we missed pages for the db-replica-lag alerts during the 03:40 on-call handoff. I never got paged.

Nora: I also didn't get a page. I assumed the bot would pick up and tag the on-call. I only saw the channel thread now. @incident-bot didn't ping the rotation.

incident-bot: Attempted to trigger PagerDuty incident for rule `db-replica-lag` at 2026-03-15T03:39:11Z. Response: 403 Forbidden. PD error: {\"error\":\"Invalid API Key\"} (request_id=pd_403_ab12)

Maya: I'm looking at incident-bot logs — seeing a steady stream of 403s starting at 03:39:10 UTC right after a config deploy. Suspect webhook/API token mismatch with PagerDuty.

Sanjay: Checking secrets rotation logs. There was an automated rotate job (secrets-rotator) at 02:58 UTC that rotated the pd-webhook token for `incident-bot` but the deploy step to push the new secret to the bot's runtime failed on one instance. So some pods have new token, some still have old token -> 403s from the ones with old token.

Maya: Paste from the bot log (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T03:39:11Z] incident-bot POST https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents -> 403 {"error":"Invalid API key"} pd_request: abc123
[2026-03-15T03:39:12Z] incident-bot POST https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents -> 200 {"incident": {"id":"PDIJ34567"}} pd_request: abc124
```
This explains intermittent paging failure.

Eli: We lost ~4 pages between 03:39 and 03:42. Alert counts: 7 total triggers, 3 successfully paged, 4 failed. Customer impact: two enterprise customers reported delayed incident acknowledgements (support tickets 9834, 9835) — no data loss, but slower response.

Nora: Immediate mitigation I did: called the primary on-call phone group, left a voicemail, and then escalated via PagerDuty web UI manually once Sanjay confirmed some PD calls were succeeding. I posted an update in the support tickets.

Sanjay: Temporary remediation steps I ran:
1) Forced a restart of incident-bot deployment to pick up latest secret on remaining pods.
2) Re-applied the secret in secrets-manager to ensure consistent version across clusters.
3) Verified PD API returns 200 for test triggers.

Maya: Verified manual test after restart:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -H "Authorization: Token token=<SANITIZED_TOKEN>" \
 -d '{"incident": {"type": "incident", "title": "test - pd integration"}}'
# Response: 200 OK {"incident": {"id":"PDIJ99999"}}
```
Paging resumed at 03:44 UTC.

incident-bot: Note: fallback paging channel `sms-gateway` is currently disabled (flag: fallback_sms=false). Recommend re-enabling while we harden rotation flows for critical alerts.

Eli: Timeline summary for the postmortem:
- 02:58 UTC: automated secret rotation job ran (secrets-rotator).
- 03:10 UTC: deploy of incident-bot config attempted; one instance failed to pick up secret (partial rollout).
- 03:39 UTC: db-replica-lag alert fires repeatedly; some paging requests returned 403 -> missed pages.
- 03:42 UTC: manual phone escalation by Nora.
- 03:44 UTC: restart and secret re-apply by Sanjay; paging restored.

Maya: Action items (short-term):
- Add a CI check that verifies all pods have the same secrets version after rotation (owner: Sanjay).
- Add a metrics alert for PD 4xx response rate > 1% over 5m routed to eng-sre (owner: Maya).
- Re-enable SMS fallback for critical alert rules during rotations (owner: Eli).

Sanjay: Created INFRA-2345 to track secret rollout verification and INFRA-2346 to re-enable fallback with rate limits. I'll link runbook PR shortly.

Nora: I'll update the on-call handoff checklist to include quick PD sanity check (send a test trigger) and confirmation that incident-bot successfully pages on all instances before sign-off.

Eli: Customer comms: I've drafted a short note to affected customers in the two tickets explaining the cause and mitigation. Will push after the postmortem draft.

Maya: Postmortem owners: INFRA-2345 assigned to Sanjay, runbook PR assigned to Maya, handoff checklist update assigned to Nora. I'll put together a timeline and root-cause analysis doc.

incident-bot: Automatically adding tag `paging-integration` to this thread.

Eli: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've acknowledged your action items.

Nora: :thumbsup:
Sanjay: :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: :white_check_mark:
